# Pool Furniture Supply

> > Commercial pool and patio furniture supplier featuring Tropitone, Telescope Casual, and STM Industries products for hotels, resorts, and outdoor hospitality spaces.

Pool Furniture Supply specializes in commercial-grade outdoor furniture including chaise lounges, modular seating, dining tables, bar stools, and fire pit tables. The catalog features weather-resistant materials like aluminum frames, eco weave, vinyl straps, and sintered stone tops designed for poolside and patio use in hospitality environments.
